subject: Re: BCP evidence request — RTO/RPO, restore tests & DR matrix
messages:
From: Anna Jenkins <anna.jenkins@clearbank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearBank Security Team <security@clearbank.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: BCP evidence request — RTO/RPO, restore tests & DR matrix

Hi Ben,

As part of our audit for our upcoming integration review (contract reference CB-2026-07), the security team asked for a concise package of Redwood's business continuity and disaster recovery evidence focused on RTO/RPO and restore validations. Specifically we need: 

- Current RTO and RPO commitments for the hosted API and Dedicated clusters used by ClearBank (any model-/route-level caveats).
- Most recent full-restore test summary (date, scope, pass/fail, time to restore, delta to RTO).
- A one-page DR matrix showing failover tiers, responsible teams, and recovery steps.
- Copies or excerpts of DR runbooks and runbook owners.
- Retention/backups cadence and location for KV caches / model artifacts.
- Signed attestation of the above (for our compliance folder).

If possible, we need these items by EOD Dec 1 so we can include them in the compliance packet for our internal auditors. Let me know if Redwood can provide a packaged zip or a shared S3 location.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Anna Jenkins
Senior Security Analyst, ClearBank
anna.jenkins@clearbank.com

Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Jenkins <anna.jenkins@clearbank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: BCP evidence request — RTO/RPO, restore tests & DR matrix

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. We can get this to you by Dec 1. Proposed plan:

1) I will assemble a package with the RTO/RPO attestation, the requested DR matrix, and a short summary of retention/backup scope.
2) Monica will attach the most recent restore test summary and S3 logs.
3) Priyom will pull the runbook excerpts and provide named owners.

Monica / Priyom / Vivek — I’ve put you on the thread so we can coordinate timelines. Can each of you confirm you can supply the items below by EOD Nov 30 so I can package and send to ClearBank Dec 1?

- Monica: latest full-restore test summary (pass/fail + timing), s3 logs CSV, any screenshots from the restore job.
- Priyom: DR runbook excerpt(s) that describe the restore sequence and owners (TXT or PDF).
- Vivek: quick matrix (XLSX) mapping failure scenarios to recovery tiers and SLOs; include any model-specific caveats.

I’ll draft the attestation once I have the technical inputs. If you need a formatter for the ZIP or a sharable S3 path, let me know and I’ll create one.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference

Team,

Summary of asks (copying ClearBank thread): RTO/RPO commitments, latest full-restore test, DR matrix, runbook excerpts, retention/backup details, signed attestation. Deadline from customer: Dec 1.

Concrete deliverables I need from you by EOD Nov 30: 
- restore_test_summary_2026-10-15.pdf — Monica (include exact elapsed restore time and any notes on remediation required).
- s3-restore-logs-20261015.csv — Monica (path + SHA256).
- dr_runbook_excerpt.txt — Priyom (sections on restore procedure and contact list).
- redwood_dr_matrix_v1.3.xlsx — Vivek (matrix should highlight which tier ClearBank sits in and realistic RTO/RPO ranges).

Also flag any items that are redacted for security reasons (we should call them out in the attestation). If you think any of the requested artifacts are internal-only and require an exception, escalate to me now so we can propose an alternative.

I’ll assemble the ZIP, draft the attestation, and send to Anna once we have all items.

Thanks — Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Ben / Priyom — attaching the artifacts requested. Short notes inline: 

- restore_test_summary_2026-10-15.pdf (attached): Full end-to-end restore of a Dedicated cluster snapshot from eu-west-1. Scope: control plane + model artifacts + KV cache warmup. Result: PASS. Total time to functional restore: 01:12:34 (production equivalence smoke tests completed). Noted gap: we observed cache warmup latency that added ~4–6 minutes under heavy load; mitigation notes included.

- s3-restore-logs-20261015.csv (attached): contains step-level timestamps for the restore job and SHA256 checksums of restored artifacts. Path: s3://redwood-evidence/clearbank/RED-5421/restore-20261015/ (read-only link below).

- dr_runbook_excerpt.txt (attached): sections 4–6 describing the restore sequence and on-call contacts (redacted phone numbers).

I uploaded the package to a temporary S3 path for sharing with ClearBank: https://s3.redwood.ai/clearbank-evidence/RED-5421/restore-20261015/. Access set to tokenized read-only link; we should include a short TTL note in the attestation.

Let me know if you want me to attach the full runbook PDF — I redacted some internal service maps that are not cleared for external sharing.

Attachments: restore_test_summary_2026-10-15.pdf; s3-restore-logs-20261015.csv; dr_runbook_excerpt.txt

— Monica

Anna — thanks for the request and for the timeline. Attached (and linked) is a consolidated package for ClearBank: 

What we are providing now (attached / shared):
- rto_rpo_attestation_nov2026.pdf — brief signed attestation with the RTO/RPO ranges we operate against for hosted API and Dedicated pools, and callouts for model-variant caveats.
- redwood_dr_matrix_v1.3.xlsx — recovery tier matrix showing primary/secondary regions, on-call owners, and expected recovery windows.
- restore_test_summary_2026-10-15.pdf — full summary and timing metrics (PASS).
- s3-restore-logs-20261015.csv — step-level logs (CSV) and checksums.
- dr_runbook_excerpt.txt — restored procedure excerpt suitable for external review (sensitive maps redacted).

Shared link (read-only, tokenized, TTL 14 days): https://s3.redwood.ai/clearbank-evidence/RED-5421/restore-20261015/
HubSpot record for this request: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/contacts/54321

Notes / clarifications:
- RTO/RPO: For Dedicated pools we operate to a 60–90 minute RTO for full failover across regions depending on model artifact size; single-region hosted API fallbacks may be shorter, see attestation for exact language.
- The October full-restore shown validated the end-to-end restore and functional smoke tests; cache warmup added ~4–6 minutes under load (we included mitigation notes in the summary).
- Items redacted: internal network topology diagrams and on-call pager numbers; we included on-call names and escalation emails in the runbook excerpt.

If you need us to add more formal wording to the attestation or produce a signed corporate letter on Redwood letterhead, I can procure that from Legal — please indicate whether that is required for your auditors.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk through the artifacts if helpful.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference
